newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for April 3.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for April 3.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open to larger ships on Thursday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1600 GMT daily meteorological report.
San Felipe port was shut to smaller fishing and tourism craft because of winds up to 20 km per hour.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.

Some clouds and colder temperatures along northern coast, Baja California and Sonora states, with maximum winds from 15 to 20 knots (28 to 38 km/16 to 22 miles per hour) and waves six to eight feet. Conditions expected to improve later in the day.

Light rains and wind gusts along coast of Tamaulipas as a warm front moved toward the region. Clear skies along rest of coastline with maximum winds 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 22 miles per hour) and waves three to six feet high.
Hot and partly cloudy with with moderate winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
